title: 第15章 休生养息陈阳进阶第16章 灵力冲击山林异动
content_zh:
三日之后，余老和阵师刘子豪一同返回了杨家。
刘子豪一到地方就赞叹杨家建的真不错，选的地方也好。
“有河流田地，有亭台楼阁，又有高山石崖，还有草木绵延，这位家主大人是真有眼光。”
来到山崖的禁地处，杨贯峰出来迎接了两人。
“阵师大人一路奔波，辛苦了。”
“家主客气了，谈不上辛苦，我不过是收钱办事而已。”
“那咱们就开始？”
“行，没问题。”
大家都是爽快人，也就没有再继续客套，直接进入正题。
刘子豪围着杨家禁地走了好几圈，仔细观察了地势和灵气走向，给出了方案。
“就用《云山雾阵》，你们杨家依山傍水，有高度水汽也足够，很适合，而且这个阵法拥有警戒能力的同时，还能隔绝外界视线。”
“可以，就按刘阵师说的办。”
之后的一个月，刘子豪便呆在了杨家，为禁地布置阵法。
灵虎和灵清已经被转移到山下的杨家院落，刘子豪并不知晓他们的存在。
只有杨灵睿会时不时出来帮他打打下手。
一个月后，全新的阵法修建完毕。
聚气中期级别的云山雾阵，不会被那磁石干扰，杨家禁地的安全性也算有了一定保障。
“杨家主，若是以后杨家需要布置防御阵法，也可以找我，老顾客我都会给折扣的。”
“一定，此番多谢刘阵师了。”
刘子豪走后三个孩子重新返回禁地，恢复了日常修炼。

在这期间，杨贯峰也从余老口中得知了异石的消息。
陈阳当时也在场，听到后感觉有几分道理。
“异石，倒是和自己的情况比较吻合。”
只是异石这种奇物毕竟稀有，鱼岭江坊市内的藏书楼也只有大致介绍，没有详细的记载。
杨贯峰和余老对着他研究了一阵，也没搞清楚个所以然。
于是他们打算再过一段时间，等陈阳品质提升之后再看看情况。
剩下便是与宗门接触的事宜。
杨贯峰从很早前就想要与宗门接触，但当时时机不成熟，也一直没有方向和门路。
余老这次带回来的两个宗门的消息就显得十分重要了。
两个宗门的情况。
万化门，位于小松山西北两千里处，门主是通灵初期的修为，门中弟子近千人，每十年会对外招收一次弟子，去年刚招完，宗门功法温和，门风正派，以五行术法为主...
content_en:
Three days later, Mr. Yu and formation master Liu Zihao returned to the Yang family.
As soon as Liu Zihao arrived at the place, he praised the Yang family for building it well and choosing a good place.
"There are rivers and fields, pavilions and pavilions, mountains and stone cliffs, and endless grass and trees. This master of the family is really discerning."
Arriving at the forbidden area on the cliff, Yang Guanfeng came out to greet the two of them.
"Master Array Master, thank you for your hard work for traveling all the way."
"Master, you're welcome. It's not hard work. I'm just collecting money to do things."
"Then let's get started?"
"Okay, no problem."
Everyone is a cheerful person, so they didn’t continue to be polite and went directly to the topic.
Liu Zihao walked around the Yang family's forbidden area several times, carefully observed the terrain and the direction of the spiritual energy, and came up with a plan.
"Just use the "Yunshan Fog Formation". Your Yang family is surrounded by mountains and rivers. It has enough water vapor and is very suitable. Moreover, while this formation has warning capabilities, it can also isolate the outside world."
"Okay, just do as Master Liu said."
For the next month, Liu Zihao stayed at Yang's house to arrange formations for the forbidden area.
Linghu and Lingqing have been moved to the Yang family courtyard down the mountain, and Liu Zihao is unaware of their existence.
Only Yang Lingrui would come out to help him from time to time.
A month later, the new formation was completed.
The Yunshan Fog Array at the mid-stage Qi Gathering level will not be disturbed by the magnet, and the safety of the Yang family's forbidden area is guaranteed to a certain extent.
"Master Yang, if the Yang family needs to set up defensive formations in the future, you can also come to me. I will give discounts to regular customers."
"Definitely. Many thanks to Master Liu for this time."
After Liu Zihao left, the three children returned to the forbidden area and resumed their daily practice.
During this period, Yang Guanfeng also learned about the strange stone from Yu Lao.
Chen Yang was also present at the time, and felt that it made sense after hearing it.
"The strange stone is more consistent with my situation."
It's just that strange objects like strange stones are rare after all, and the library in Yulingjiangfang City only has a general introduction and no detailed records.
Yang Guanfeng and Mr. Yu studied him for a while, but couldn't figure out the reason.
So they planned to wait for a while and wait for Chen Yang's quality to improve before taking a look at the situation.
The rest is about contacting the sect.
Yang Guanfeng had wanted to contact the sect from a long time ago, but the time was not ripe at the time and he had no direction or connections.
The news about the two sects that Mr. Yu brought back this time is very important.
The situation of the two sects.
The Wanhua Sect is located two thousand miles northwest of Xiaosong Mountain. The sect leader is a cultivator in the early stage of spiritualism. There are nearly a thousand disciples in the sect. It recruits disciples every ten years. The recruitment was just completed last year. The sect's martial arts are gentle and upright, focusing on the five elements...
